parent_objective: audit M2293 measured execution completeness and outcome distribution without ranking or repair
blocked_by: M2293 produced complete measured execution data and must be audited before interpretation
supersedes: direct profile ranking from M2293 aggregates
direct repair from M2293 outcome rates without audit

public_gates: M2294 must not rerun measured execution
M2294 must verify M2293 target counts, failure count, metadata completeness, metric completeness, and guardrail count
M2294 must classify global and role-family dominant failure modes
M2294 must choose a non-ranking next route
M2294 must not rank profiles, select a winner, or claim paper/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the first complete 1080-episode role-family measured execution panel and selects the next evidence route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit and route selection only; no ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2293 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if audit cannot classify the dominant failure mode
stop if profile aggregates are being interpreted as ranking evidence
stop if next route would repair without diagnosing offtrack/collision structure
fallback_plan: route to runner/data repair if M2293 artifacts are inconsistent
route to failure-slice diagnosis if offtrack or collision dominates
route to branch synthesis if measured data invalidates the scenario task-family route
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: workflow cadence reached after M2283 plus M2284-M2293 scenario task-family execution milestones

training_stage.stage_objective: audit measured execution data and select next non-ranking route
admission_evidence: M2293 failure_count, metadata_missing_count, metric_completeness_failure_count, and guardrail_violation_count are all zero
allowed_updates: M2294 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2294 audits measured execution outcomes and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2294.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat weak measured outcomes as scenario/task-performance evidence only until follow-up diagnosis.

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns complete closed-loop scenario panel data into an explicit next-route decision
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can identify whether current-sim task quality now needs failure slicing, reward/control repair, or branch synthesis
must_synthesize_if: M2294 cannot select a non-ranking route
M2294 finds the measured panel is not interpretable
M2294 would continue narrow repairs without expanding evidence

hypothesis: M2293 measured execution artifacts can be audited to classify outcome structure and choose the next non-ranking route without making profile ranking or paper/self-ID claims.
success_criteria: M2293 episode_count, scenario_spec_count, selected_checkpoint_count, failure_count, metadata_missing_count, metric_completeness_failure_count, and guardrail_violation_count are verified
global dominant failure mode is classified
role-family dominant failure modes are summarized
a non-ranking follow-up route is pre-registered
failure_criteria: M2294 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2294 changes scenario specs or profile configs
M2294 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2294 cannot select a next route

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual result audit over runs/m2293_paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_measured_execution/summary.json and aggregate CSVs

decision_rule: M2294 passes if it verifies M2293 completeness, classifies the outcome distribution, and pre-registers a non-ranking follow-up route.
